# Third-party assets

agrelha embeds these files in its binary. Their licences require the notice to
travel with the copy, so the texts are kept here.

| Asset | Version | Licence | Notice |
|---|---|---|---|
| `internal/web/assets/js/datastar.js` | 1.0.2 | MIT | [datastar-LICENSE.md](datastar-LICENSE.md) |
| `internal/web/assets/css/output.css` | Tailwind CSS 4.3.3 | MIT | carried inline in the file's first line |
| `internal/web/assets/fonts/DepartureMono-Regular.woff2` | 1.500 | SIL OFL 1.1 | [departure-mono-LICENSE.md](departure-mono-LICENSE.md) |
| `internal/web/assets/fonts/Fraunces-Variable.woff2` | fontsource 5.2.6 | SIL OFL 1.1 | [fraunces-LICENSE.md](fraunces-LICENSE.md) |

Go module dependencies are not vendored; their licences travel with the modules
and are listed in `go.mod`.
